Ok Tedi is 100% Papua New Guinea owned, with the national government holding a majority share and the people of Western Province owning the remaining interest. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Boilermaker Technician role based in Tabubil, Western Province. The Boilermaker Technician is responsible for the fabrication, installation, repair, and maintenance of metal structures, equipment, and piping systems used in mining operations. Daily tasks include interpreting technical drawings and blueprints, performing welding and cutting activities, assembling and fitting components, and conducting inspections to identify wear, damage, or potential failures. The role involves working closely with maintenance and operations teams to schedule repairs, minimize equipment downtime, and ensure all work complies with safety, environmental, and quality standards. The Boilermaker Technician is expected to maintain accurate records of work completed, use tools and machinery safely, and actively participate in safety meetings and training. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong welding skills, including Welding and TIG Welding, suitable for heavy industrial and mining environments. Candidates should possess practical experience with Oxy-acetylene cutting and heating for fabrication, repair, and dismantling of metal components. Candidates should possess proficiency in Blueprint Reading to accurately interpret drawings, specifications, and technical documents. Candidates should possess Metal Fabrication skills for constructing, assembling, and modifying structural and mechanical components. Relevant trade qualification or apprenticeship in Boilermaking or Metal Fabrication, or equivalent recognized certification. Demonstrated experience in heavy industry, mining, or similar field-based operations, with a strong focus on safety and risk management. Ability to work in remote, rugged environments, perform physically demanding tasks, and follow safe work procedures and company policies. Effective communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across maintenance and operations teams.

review_candidates.title: Accountmanager German/French market
review_candidates.description: Jij ziet commerciële kansen over de grens. Je weet hoe je relaties opbouwt, onderhandelt over prijzen en inspeelt op wat er in de markt gebeurt. Als accountmanager bij Myne ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder ontwikkelen van onze Duitse óf Franse markt. Je bouwt aan je eigen klantenportefeuille, onderhoudt contact met bestaande klanten en gaat actief op zoek naar nieuwe kansen. Je begrijpt wat klanten nodig hebben, weet wat er speelt in de markt en zorgt ervoor dat de juiste metaalstromen bij Myne terechtkomen. Van het eerste contact tot de levering van het materiaal: jij bent betrokken bij het hele commerciële proces. Ben jij commercieel gedreven, spreek je goed Duits of Frans en krijg je energie van internationale handel, klantcontact en onderhandelen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Over Myne Bij Myne bouwen we aan de toekomst van de metaalindustrie. Wij geloven in een wereld waarin metalen oneindig worden gerecycled en grondstoffen nooit verloren gaan. Met onze innovatieve Xorter-technologie, ontwikkeld in samenwerking met de Technische Universiteit Delft, maken we hoogwaardige metaalrecycling mogelijk en dragen we iedere dag bij aan een circulaire economie. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Harderwijk werken ruim 75 enthousiaste collega's aan één gezamenlijke missie: de recyclingindustrie slimmer, duurzamer en innovatiever maken. We zijn actief op verschillende Europese markten en onze business groeit. Daarom zoeken we een accountmanager die onze Duitse of Franse markt verder wil ontwikkelen en samen met ons commerciële kansen wil benutten. Wat ga je doen als accountmanager? Als accountmanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het onderhouden en uitbreiden van klantrelaties in de Duitse óf Franse markt. Je weet hoe belangrijk goed relatiebeheer is, maar kijkt ook verder: waar liggen nieuwe kansen en hoe kunnen we onze positie in de markt versterken? Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Relatiebeheer: je onderhoudt contact met bestaande klanten en bouwt aan langdurige relaties. Dit doe je telefonisch, via e-mail en WhatsApp en door klanten persoonlijk te bezoeken. Nieuwe klanten en kansen: je gaat actief op zoek naar potentiële klanten en commerciële mogelijkheden om onze positie in de Duitse of Franse markt verder uit te bouwen. Inkoop en onderhandelen: je onderhandelt over prijzen en voorwaarden en zorgt ervoor dat Myne de juiste metaalstromen kan inkopen tegen aantrekkelijke voorwaarden. Marktkennis: je volgt de ontwikkelingen in de metaalhandel, houdt prijsontwikkelingen in de gaten en weet wat er speelt bij klanten en concurrenten. De volledige klantreis: van het eerste contact en de prijsafspraken tot de levering en afwikkeling van het materiaal. Je houdt overzicht en zorgt dat afspraken worden nagekomen. Je werkt samen in een commercieel team van 12 collega's, verdeeld over verschillende Europese markten. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om je eigen markt en klantenportefeuille te beheren. Samen met je collega's wissel je kennis uit, signaleer je kansen en werk je aan de verdere groei van Myne. Wie ben jij? Je Bent Commercieel Ingesteld, Legt Gemakkelijk Contact En Vindt Het Leuk Om Relaties Op Te Bouwen Én Resultaten Te Behalen. Je Neemt Initiatief, Denkt In Kansen En Kunt Snel Schakelen Wanneer De Markt Of Een Klant Daarom Vraagt. Je Werkt Zelfstandig, Maar Weet Ook Wanneer Je Collega's Nodig Hebt Om Samen Verder Te Komen. Daarnaast Heb Je Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding. Ongeveer 2 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in accountmanagement, sales, internationale handel of een vergelijkbare commerciële functie. Een goede beheersing van de Duitse óf Franse taal, zodat je zelfstandig met klanten in die markt kunt communiceren. Een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal. Nederlands is mooi meegenomen. Ervaring met relatiebeheer, onderhandelen en het onderhouden van klantcontact. Een proactieve, ondernemende en resultaatgerichte houding. Interesse in marktontwikkelingen, commercie en de toekomst van de metaalindustrie. Ervaring in de metaalhandel, recycling of een andere handelsomgeving is mooi meegenomen, maar geen must. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je commercieel inzicht hebt, graag met klanten werkt en bereid bent om je de markt en onze materialen eigen te maken. Waarom werken bij Myne? Bij Myne Krijg Je De Ruimte Om Zelf Kansen Te Creëren, Een Internationaal Netwerk Op Te Bouwen En Bij Te Dragen Aan De Groei Van Onze Organisatie. Je Krijgt Verantwoordelijkheid Over Je Eigen Markt En Hebt Direct Invloed Op De Commerciële Resultaten. Dat Betekent Een salaris van € 3.500 tot € 5.500 bruto per maand, passend bij jouw ervaring. 8% vakantiegeld. Een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van performance. 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen. Een goede bedrijfspensioenregeling. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken. Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Een open en transparante organisatie met korte lijnen en een informele werksfeer. Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Regelmatige sociale activiteiten en een sportprogramma. Werken aan een duurzame missie die impact maakt. Klaar om als accountmanager internationaal impact te maken? Wil jij jouw commerciële talent inzetten om de Duitse of Franse markt verder te ontwikkelen? En lijkt het je leuk om onderdeel te worden van een groeiende organisatie die werkt aan een duurzamere metaalindustrie? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw commerciële drive en hoe jij kansen ziet voor Myne. Nadat je gesolliciteerd hebt, wordt er binnen 2 dagen contact met je opgenomen. Tijdens een eerste gesprek maak je kennis met Thomas en Koos. We zijn benieuwd naar jou, je ervaring en vooral naar hoe jij denkt en waarom je graag bij onze organisatie zou willen werken. Is er van beide kanten een klik? Dan volgt een tweede gesprek met een van je toekomstige collega's uit het commerciële team. Daarna maak je online een persoonlijkheidstest. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan verwelkomen we je graag als onze nieuwe accountmanager. Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem gerust contact op met onze recruiter Sonja via recruitment@myne.eco of bel/app naar 06-83544687.

Month-End Close & Reporting: Assist with month-end close, including journal entries, accruals, and account reconciliations, and help prepare monthly financial statements and management reports. Process Improvement & Automation: Identify opportunities to streamline accounting workflows, reduce manual work, and improve accuracy through better tools, integrations, and automation. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, reconciliation workbooks). Familiarity with ACH, wire, and online payment platforms. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over accuracy and deadlines. Clear communicator who is comfortable working with internal teams and following up with clients and partners on billing and payment matters. Innovative Culture: Join a team that values curiosity, challenges the status quo, and celebrates every win. Career Growth: As the company and finance team expand, this role offers a clear path toward greater responsibility and senior finance positions. Competitive Compensation: We offer a competitive salary and benefits package.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Maintenance Engineer - Night Shift
review_candidates.description: Company Description Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises. Zayo is seeking a Senior Network Maintenance Engineer to be responsible for the overall management, coordination, and evaluation of the planned activity on the Zayo network. This includes ensuring that all changes are effectively planned, communicated and executed with minimal risk to network operations to minimize risks and service disruptions. The Senior Network Maintenance Engineer acts as the central point of contact for change requests, collaborates with stakeholders, and enforces adherence to change management policies and procedures. Please Note: This position schedule is Night Shift Only. Schedule : Front Half Nights: 7pm - 7am CST Days: (Sun/Mon/Tues/Wed) Rotate EOW: Mon/Tues/Wed NOTE : The team is open to this role located anywhere in the United States. The schedule is CST. The Senior Network Maintenance Engineer also accepts and reviews maintenance requests from internal and 3rd party organizations, identifying the impact to customer services created by the maintenance activities using inventory records and logging into SONET and DWDM equipment to verify, notifying customers of the expected impact and duration through formal maintenance notifications, and when necessary, re-provisioning customer circuits to mitigate impact as a result of maintenance activities. Responsibilities: Responsible for all aspects of the Zayo network maintenance process including scheduling network maintenance activities, identifying customer impact using inventory systems and by logging in to advanced network tools and systems, issuing notifications to customers of maintenance events, provisioning customer circuits (if necessary), and closing out maintenance activities upon successful validation of completion. Review service orders to assess potential (circuit) impact of maintenance events, and determine customer services impact and provide notifications to customers on potentially impacted services based on customer preference. Accurately evaluate the impact, risk, and urgency of each change in collaboration with technical teams and stakeholders. Interact directly with internal and external leadership and executive staff on change management ticket acceptance, impacts, and moratorium exceptions. Interact with customers via written and oral communications, answering customer questions, addressing customer concerns, adjusting processes for customer specific requirements, and generally delivering a high level of customer satisfaction with the Zayo maintenance processes. Interact with other Zayo internal organizations to schedule & coordinate maintenance activities, ensure that proper policies are followed, and drive continuous improvement in the Zayo maintenance processes. Coordinate with third party providers to Zayo to ensure they provide ample notification of service impacting maintenance activities, including adequate definition of scope to be performed and anticipated timeframes of service impact. Escalate within the management chain of third party organizations when maintenance notifications are inadequate, lacking in sufficient detail or advance notification. Act as a liaison between technical teams, management, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on change-related activities. Communicate change plans, schedules, and potential impacts to all relevant parties, including impacted customers. Identify potential risks associated with proposed changes and develop mitigation strategies. Act as the escalation point during change implementation to resolve conflicts or unexpected issues. Coordinate rollback plans and contingency measures for failed or problematic changes. Conduct pre-implementation and post-implementation reviews with stakeholders to gather feedback and improve future processes. Perform special projects and other duties as assigned. Act as a subject matter expert on our platforms and technologies. Mentor and develop Network Maintenance Engineers. Identify areas for departmental and process improvements and make recommendations to leadership. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or two-year College degree or technical school diploma and additional related experience and/or training; or at least 11 years of directly related experience required. Minimum of seven (7) years of experience in change management, network operations, or a similar role in the telecom industry. Expertise with ITIL frameworks (ITIL Foundation certification preferred). Expert knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel as well as the trouble ticketing and circuit inventory software. Expert knowledge of fiber optic network equipment and architectures, including SONET and DWDM equipment. Expertise with Telecom NOC operations and workflows. Expertise with telecom network technologies (e.g., IP/MPLS, LTE/5G, Fiber Optics). Expertise in Change Management tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Remedy). Expertise in monitoring tools used in NOC operations. Must be able to interpret impact based on technical documentation. Must be able to read technical documents, interpret potential impact, and translate to multiple stakeholders including Technical personnel and outside customers. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Great customer service skills. Effective interpersonal skills. Exceptional attention to process, documentation, and details. Able to multitask and work on several projects simultaneously. Work nights and/or weekends as scheduled or necessary by workload or emergency maintenance activities. Work well as a part of a team as well as be able to perform as an individual with minimal supervision. Dependable. Able to train and develop less experienced Engineers. Estimated base salary range: $95,100 - $146,300 USD/annually. The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan. Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off. The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled. Benefits, Rewards & Wellness Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. As part of the application, hiring, onboarding, and/or employment process, Zayo or its affiliates, partners, and vendors may collect, store, and use biometric identifiers and biometric information (collectively, “Biometric Data”), such as fingerprints, facial geometry scans or other unique biological characteristics. Zayo uses CLEAR1, a third-party identity verification service, to verify applicant identity during the hiring process. CLEAR1 may collect Biometric Data, including facial geometry scans and/or other biometric identifiers, to authenticate your identity. Biometric Data will be retained pursuant to CLEAR1’s policies, which can be found here: https://www.clearme.com/clear1-credential-policy-crp. Zayo will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from any applicant's or employee's Biometric Data. By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge this disclosure. Prior to any collection of Biometric Data — including through CLEAR — you may be presented with a separate consent form and asked to provide your written authorization in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), the Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI), and other applicable biometric privacy statutes.

review_candidates.title: Regional Account Manager - Egypt
review_candidates.description: WE ARE HIRING. Talkpush is hiring sales professionals, product managers, marketers, and developers to join its team. Most positions are based in our offices all over the globe: San Francisco, India, Philippines, Costa Rica, Mexico, and Hong Kong. Intelligent and ideological candidates interested in changing the world of recruitment are welcome to apply. Just have a chat with us on our website or on our Facebook page. Read more about the Talkpush culture here. ⚠️ DON'T APPLY FOR A JOB AT TALKPUSH IF THIS IS YOU Recruitment is one of the oldest, most established industries, and we're out to change it completely through automation. To make that dream come true, we need people with a fire in their belly who would rather deliver unpleasant truths to customers rather than slap together a quick fix. This isn't a 9-to-5 job that delivers the same experience every day, but a place where once in a while, you wake up with a burning desire to implement a new solution and to test the heck out of it. This means that people who think sucking up to the boss or being a yes-person is the path to success, who aren't willing to stand behind their idea, even in the face of pushback, who prefer change to be predictable and gradual, won't be very happy here. They might be smart, kind, and lovely, but this isn't their pot's lid. If you're the kind of person who gets a little obsessed about a problem and can't think of anything else until you can puzzle it out, we can offer interesting challenges, an international team that will challenge you, and a mission to help millions of people get hired by focusing relentlessly on building better candidate experiences. Does this sound a little scary and overly ambitious? Good, that's just how we like it. ✨ Regional Account Manager - Egypt Location: Must be based in Egypt Salary: Up to 160,000 EGP/month Product Focus: AI-Powered Recruitment Technology A Quick Note About Our Process We use AI-powered screening in the early stages to review applications consistently and fairly. Both screening and interviews will be conducted in English. Our team reviews every application — AI is there to support their decisions, not replace them. About Talkpush At Talkpush, we build AI-powered recruitment automation that helps large organizations hire faster and deliver a better candidate experience at scale. Our platform is used by some of the world's largest BPOs, banks, and logistics companies, across more than 30 countries. We're a remote-first company with a globally distributed team, and we're genuinely passionate about where technology meets human connection in hiring. The Role We already have customers in Egypt. Now we need someone on the ground who can turn that foothold into a real, defensible local position. Role This isn't a standard account manager or business development role. You'll own all three dimensions of local commercial growth in one country: Protect and grow our existing anchor account(s) — you're the face of Talkpush in the market Build relationships with the top 30–40 enterprise employers in the country through account-based outreach Feed local market insight back to the team: case studies, messaging feedback, partner identification, and event participation Think of this as roughly 60% commercial ownership, 25% market development, and 15% localization and GTM support. What You'll Do Manage and grow the anchor customer relationship, building strong local credibility and references for Talkpush Map the local enterprise recruitment market and build relationships with target accounts Run patient, structured outreach to named accounts — this is relationship-building, not cold calling Contribute to local case studies and commercial materials that make Talkpush more compelling in the market Participate in and help host local webinars and HR community events Feed market insight back to product, marketing, and commercial leadership What We're Looking For Someone who has built a solid commercial foundation in tech or SaaS, has real, hands-on experience managing or supporting enterprise accounts, and is now looking for a role where they can own a market end to end. Someone energized by the long game: earning trust, building relationships, and growing something meaningful over time, rather than chasing a fast pipeline. You Should Apply If You're a native Arabic speaker and based in Egypt Your commercial background is in tech, SaaS, or a sector where enterprise relationships are the norm; you have real, hands-on experience supporting or managing large accounts, and understand the patience long-cycle relationships require You're commercially credible with senior decision-makers and comfortable managing long-cycle relationships You can manage yourself and work well remotely with limited day-to-day direction You're curious enough to contribute beyond account management alone — you want to help shape how Talkpush shows up locally Bonus Points If You have a background in HR tech, ATS, recruitment, or related SaaS You have existing relationships with HR or talent acquisition leaders in your market You have international experience — you've worked or lived outside your home country You have experience hosting or attending local industry events or webinars Why This Role Own your market from day one — real ownership, not just tasks Work remotely from home with real flexibility and autonomy Join a global, AI-first recruitment technology company whose customers include some of the world's largest employers Be Talkpush's first and founding local presence in your country — leave your mark on how the market grows A 12-month pilot with a clear success target and a real path to grow with the market About Our AI-Powered Screening At Talkpush, we use our own AI-powered tool, TalkScore, as part of our application process. You may be invited to answer a short set of screening questions after applying. TalkScore helps us review applications consistently and fairly, but it doesn't make hiring decisions — every application is reviewed by a human. We use AI to support our team, not to replace human judgment.
